svg.aria-label: I · ARCHITECTURE · NORSE. The world tree links every realm through its roots and branches. That is how I think about data systems: sources at the roots, BigQuery as the trunk, and dashboards and services as the branches. Each job is small and independent, so one broken branch never takes the tree down. Odin traded an eye for wisdom; I trade shortcuts for structure.
